successors.note: 'The British took control of Freetown, making it a Crown Colony in 1808': the same land continues as a British colony; Cliopatria has no row for it after 1796 and its aggregate British Colonial Empire row has no Sierra Leone polygon.

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria starts in 1788. 'The area was settled in 1787 by 400 formerly enslaved black people sent from London' (Freetown page); Granville Town 'established in 1787 by the London-based Committee for the Relief of the Black Poor' (Province of Freedom page). One settlement site; the purchase of the wider land is not dated on either page.

3,430 km2, 1788-1795 (8.13-8.84 N, 13.32-12.66 W): unverified. The land was 'bought from King Tom and regent Naimbana' (undated on the pages; 1788 is Cliopatria's year) and neither page gives an area or boundary; the only figure is Freetown's present municipality, 82.48 km2, which is no historical measure. The shape is far wider than the sites the pages name (Granville Town 1787, Freetown 1792) and may be an overestimate of the settled land. Granville Town burned in 1789 and was rebuilt in 1791.

3,430 km2, the same outline for 1796, the last Cliopatria year. The Freetown page has no event for 1796 ('survived being pillaged by the French in 1794'; 300 to 400 houses in 1798), so the row's end looks like a data limit, not an end of the colony.

New keyframe: the colony goes on after Cliopatria's row ends in 1796: the Nova Scotians rebel in 1800 and 'the British took control of Freetown, making it a Crown Colony in 1808'. The 1796 shape is carried unchanged through 1807 (years only), low confidence.

region.text: Granville Town and the first settlement, on the Freetown peninsula

ledger.note: 1787: 400 formerly enslaved people from London settle the Province of Freedom at Granville Town. 'The area was settled in 1787 by 400 formerly enslaved black people sent from London'; the Province of Freedom page: Granville Town 'established in 1787 by the London-based Committee for the Relief of the Black Poor'.
1788: the colony's land is bought from the Temne. The land 'was bought from King Tom and regent Naimbana' but neither page dates the purchase or gives its size; 1788 is Cliopatria's first shape.

region.text: Granville Town and the first settlement, on the Freetown peninsula

ledger.note: 1789: King Jimmy burns Granville Town. 'King Jimmy, King Tom's successor, burnt the settlement to the ground in 1789'; the town was 'destroyed in 1789' (Province of Freedom page).

region.text: Granville Town and the first settlement, on the Freetown peninsula

ledger.note: 1791: Granville Town is rebuilt. 'The town was rebuilt in 1791' with help from Alexander Falconbridge, sent to Sierra Leone in 1791 to collect the remaining Black Poor settlers.
1792: Freetown is founded on 11 March and becomes the seat. 'The city of Freetown was founded on March 11, 1792' by 1,196 African Americans (Nova Scotian settlers) under Lieutenant John Clarkson.

1792: the Province of Freedom becomes the Freetown or Sierra Leone Colony. The Province of Freedom page: 'The Freetown Colony was established on 11 March 1792'; the Freetown page: the old settlers were incorporated into the new Sierra Leone Colony on 24 August 1792 under the Sierra Leone Company.

1808: Freetown becomes a British Crown Colony. 'The British took control of Freetown, making it a Crown Colony in 1808.' The Nova Scotians had rebelled in 1800 and about 550 Jamaican Maroons arrived to suppress the rising.

wars.outcome: King Jimmy 'burnt the settlement to the ground'; the Province of Freedom lapsed until Granville Town was rebuilt in 1791.

wars.name: French raid on Freetown
wars.outcome: Freetown 'survived being pillaged by the French in 1794' and was rebuilt by the settlers; no territory moved.

certainty.note: The pages give no boundary or area for the colony; the Cliopatria shape (1788-1796) is an unverified envelope.

notes: CLIOPATRIA ROW. 'Freetown Colony' 1788-1796 (two shapes, both 3,430 km2). The wikipedia title is 'Freetown' (Q3780), so the row stands for the whole story of the Province of Freedom (1787) and the Sierra Leone Company's colony (1792), which the pages carry to the Crown Colony of 1808. I extended the dossier to 1787-1808 (new keyframes 1787 and 1797-1807) because the pages give no end in 1796; the extension is low confidence. AREA. No page opened gives an extent; Freetown's municipal 82.48 km2 is no comparison; the shape is unverified and probably too large for the settled land. The 1788 purchase from King Tom and regent Naimbana is not dated on either page. NOT SETTLED. The Sierra Leone Company's charter and the Crown purchase of 1807-08, the Temne (Koya) kingdom as a state, and the colony's extent after 1792 need a page (the Wikipedia articles 'Sierra Leone Company' or 'Colony of Sierra Leone' were not opened: page budget 1-2). The Cliopatria relation (British Empire umbrella, 1788-1796) is carried by british-colonial-empire.
